name: Walker Tienkung · Voice & Vision
summary: UBTECH Walker Tienkung · Voice & Vision (product model TK2201): the middle model of UBTECH's Walker Tienkung series. Per UBTECH's user manual: 1730 ± 10 mm, 68 kg net, 21 integrated joints (arms 4 × 2, waist 1, legs 6 × 2), no dexterous hands, three RGB-D cameras, a voice module, one NVIDIA Orin AGX 64 development unit (275 TOPS) plus an Intel i7-1355U motion-control unit, dual battery with more than 3.5 h endurance. Intended by UBTECH for scientific research and education. A separate model from Walker Tienkung · Embodied Intelligence (TK2301) and the base Walker Tienkung (TK2101).
